topic: The Magic of Dandelin Spheres: Unlocking Conic Sections
target_audience: High school students or undergraduate mathematics enthusiasts

sections.title: Prerequisites: The Anatomy of a Cone and Plane
lecture_lines: Visualize a double napped cone meeting at a vertex.
A slicing plane cuts through the cone surface.
The plane's angle determines the intersection shape.
animations: Draw double-napped cone with #FFFFFF outline; highlight vertex in #FFD700.
Draw plane slicing through the cone in #00FFFF.
Emphasize plane angle changing and intersection curve in #FF4500.

sections.title: Introducing the Dandelin Spheres
lecture_lines: They touch the cone in a perfect circle.
They touch the plane at a single point.
animations: Animate two Dandelin spheres appearing inside cone in #FF00FF.
Trace circles where spheres touch the cone surface in #FFFFFF.
Mark points where spheres touch the slicing plane in #FFD700.

sections.title: Visual Proof: The Ellipse Case
lecture_lines: Points on an ellipse follow a constant sum distance.
Dandelin spheres bridge this geometry to algebra.
The sphere tangency points are the ellipse foci.
Distance to foci is constant for every point.
This explains the definition of an ellipse.
animations: Show plane cutting cone surface at ellipse angle in #00FF00.
Place spheres tangent to plane and cone interior.
Highlight tangency points as ellipse foci using #FFD700.
Draw segment from ellipse point to foci in #FFFFFF.
Show constant segment sum property with moving point animation.

sections.title: Generalization to Parabola and Hyperbola
lecture_lines: Adjusting the plane slope changes the conic shape.
The parabola moves one sphere to infinity.
The hyperbola sphere moves to the other nap.
animations: Rotate plane until parallel to cone side for parabola.
Move sphere until tangency occurs at infinity for parabola.
Rotate plane to cut both naps for hyperbola case.

sections.title: Summary and Conclusion
lecture_lines: Dandelin spheres connect 3D cones to 2D geometry.
They reveal the foci as the conic DNA.
Geometry and algebra unite through these spheres.
animations: Show ellipse, parabola, and hyperbola side-by-side in #FFFFFF.
Flash foci points on all three shapes in #FFD700.
Display final conclusion text: 'Spheres Reveal Conic DNA'.
